Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
A couple of weeks ago I said (in error) that if you steal a weapon, you can
turn around and use it that round. The rulebook, of course, says that you
can't do this, but I had forgotten to double check the rulebook before
posting that (doh!). So no, there hasn't been errata to the rules in this
case, I just had a memory lapse.

Since there have been a couple of posts asking about that, which have scrolled
off to due to overload and going on vacation last weekend, I figured
I should post this.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
